RAG Assistant project at /Users/dmitrypotekhin/projects/rag-assistant/. Tech: FastAPI + ChromaDB + sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) + DeepSeek API (chat). Local macOS app with voice control via Handy.app, Obsidian notes, web UI. Embedding: sentence-transformers (not Ollama). LLM: DeepSeek API (key via DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env var).

When Ollama is not installed or available, sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, ~90MB, pip install) is a reliable pure-Python embedding alternative — no server needed, 384-dim embeddings, works on CPU.
